scripts.postinstall: cd web-app && npm install && cd ../seller-workspace && npm install && cd ../shoppay && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,seller,pay,warm -c blue,green,magenta,gray "npm --prefix web-app run dev" "npm --prefix seller-workspace run dev" "npm --prefix shoppay run dev" "bash scripts/warmup.sh"
scripts.dev:webpack: concurrently -n web,seller,pay -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix web-app run dev -- --webpack" "npm --prefix seller-workspace run dev -- --webpack" "npm --prefix shoppay run dev -- --webpack"
scripts.db:push: cd web-app && npx drizzle-kit push && cd ../seller-workspace && npm run db:push && cd ../shoppay && npm run db:push
